title: pixi-policy facts
description: What `pixi policy facts` writes: every environment and platform of pixi.lock with its packages, as input for a policy engine such as OPA. Version 1: fields may be added; a renamed or removed field raises the version.

workspace.description: Paths relative to the working directory when inside it, as given otherwise.

environments.description: One entry per environment and platform pixi.lock locks: `default` first, the rest by name, each platform by name.

platform.description: A conda platform: linux-64, osx-arm64, win-64, ...

kind.description: A conda archive from a channel or URL, a conda package pixi builds from source, or a PyPI wheel or source distribution.

provides_pypi.description: The PyPI distributions pixi.lock states a conda package provides (conda msgpack-python provides msgpack); empty for a PyPI package.

url.description: The channel's or index's URL, or the git, archive or local location.

channel.description: The channel's name, for a conda package from one.

declared.description: As pixi.lock records it; pixi.lock records no PyPI licenses.

spdx.description: The SPDX expression pixi-policy reads it as.

timestamp.description: When a conda package was built, in seconds since 1970.
